name: Subalpine Cube Fest 2020

venue.name: [Summit Elementary School](https://wpsdk12.org/ses/)
venue.address: 490 Meadow Park Dr, Divide CO 80814, USA
venue.details: Follow the signs to the gymnasium upon entering the building.

information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This competition will be the highest ever in North America at over 9300 feet in elevation! This competition can only hold a maximum of 75 competitors, so we ask that you please try to keep guests to a minimum. Be sure to register as soon as possible to guarantee a spot in the competition. All competitors will receive a lanyard with staffing assignments and group information when they arrive at the registration table.
